verdict.rationale: Persona documents Reports as additional check types that give information about an end user beyond what they submit in an inquiry. The listed types include Address Lookup, which partly covers the address dimension, and the Mobile SDKs mention 'optimal device signals'. Phone carrier checks, email risk, and device fingerprinting are not shown as documented check types in the evidence, so only part of the story is delivered. missing for 10: documented phone/carrier risk report, email risk report, device fingerprint check type, explicit address history (vs. lookup), independent corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can enrich verifications with phone, email, and device risk signals — carrier checks, address history, device fingerprint — as additional documented check types

citations.quote: Reports provide additional information about an end user beyond what they submit directly in an inquiry.
Persona supports many report types, including: Address Lookup
